stops.text: 14 HOT MINUTE · A Taken by the haze — “Don't make me leave and go where promises, hearts,”
14 HOT MINUTE · B Floating in the black — “I escaped here for a reason”
14 HOT MINUTE · C Cross-cut: highs and lows of life — “let it feel love and lost as we must endure”
14 HOT MINUTE · D Battle scars and graytones — “can't leave behind the impulse that comes from battle scars”
14 HOT MINUTE · E The vintage door appears — “I trust that you'll be fine.”
14 HOT MINUTE · F The dance at the vintage party — “Our dance together is a victory to entwine muses”
14 HOT MINUTE · G Disappears into the crowd; door closes — “and a genesis of a New Testament as it ends.”
